name: Slime Research
desc: A scientist in town is researching slimes and needs a Droplet to complete his analysis.
complete_text: With your Droplet, the scientist completes his research!

name: Decode the Charm
desc: Sira the Fence wants a Raider's Charm to decipher goblin raiding routes.
complete_text: Sira traces the etchings and grins. The raider routes are revealed!

name: Consecrate the Ossuary
desc: Vicar Ren asks for an Ossuary Pauldron recovered from skeleton guardians.
complete_text: Ren intones a prayer and sanctifies the bonework, freeing the restless spirit.

name: Alchemical Bone Meal
desc: Vyra needs Powdered Remains to refine a potent concoction.
complete_text: Vyra claps in delight and begins infusing the powder into her tonics.

name: Scarlet Remedy
desc: Lute the Apothecary requests a Scarlet Phial harvested from cave bats.
complete_text: Lute seals the phial away, eager to distill a powerful coagulant.

name: Marsh Camouflage
desc: Kai the Pathfinder needs a Skink Scale Cloak to resume scouting the marsh.
complete_text: Kai bows gratefully and disappears back into the reeds.

name: Lantern for the Lost
desc: Exorcist Iona needs a Spirit Lantern to soothe the chapel spirits.
complete_text: Iona nods, lantern in hand, and sets about calming the restless dead.

name: Feed the Militia
desc: Cook Brum needs Troll Hearty Stew to boost the militia’s strength.
complete_text: Brum ladles the stew into kettles, whistling a victorious tune.

name: Infernal Study
desc: Pyromancer Lua seeks a Cinder Fetish taken from imps.
complete_text: Lua sketches the runes eagerly, weaving them into a new ward.

name: Shadowed Paths
desc: The Shadow Cartographer needs a Veilstone Ring from phantoms.
complete_text: With the ring, the cartographer sketches new secret routes for the town.

name: Counter the Kobolds
desc: Denn the Trapper wants a Kobold Trick Pouch to improve his defenses.
complete_text: Denn grins and scatters the reagents into new snares for the town.

name: Break the Warhorn
desc: Captain Lura needs a Clan Warhorn to decipher goblin battle calls.
complete_text: Lura studies the horn and rewrites the militia’s battle signals.

name: Quiet the Mindsong
desc: Mindseer Ava wants Psionic Gel to reinforce psychic wards.
complete_text: Ava layers the gel over her runes, dampening the psychic noise.

name: Restore the Seal
desc: Scribe Eden seeks the Censor’s Seal to return it to the royal archives.
complete_text: Eden presses the seal into wax, satisfied that justice has been recorded.
